about: Generated by `vesper-dump --transfer-matrix docs/transfer-matrix` from the engine and docs/parameter-matrix.md. Don't edit by hand.

categories.label: Transfers, adjusted
categories.meaning: Moves across, fitted to the destination: rounded, held to its range, or matched to the closest setting it has.

categories.label: Partial
categories.meaning: Part of it moves across; the note says which part doesn't.

categories.label: Doesn't transfer
categories.meaning: Doesn't move between these two consoles. VESPER lists it so you can set it by hand.

categories.label: Same console only
categories.meaning: Moves only between two consoles of the same model or family.

categories.label: Not applicable
categories.meaning: The source console doesn't have this.

categories.label: Not yet checked
categories.meaning: Not yet checked on one of the two consoles.

verified_meaning: Both consoles' ends of this were proved in that console's own software (a controlled save or a load check).

concepts.name: DCA level, mute, name and colour

cell_format_meaning: Each cell is [category id, verified, note]; note is an index into notes, or null where the category says it all.
